sessions.phase_label: Queens Collegiate and JHS 157 agreement corrections

requirements.title: Allocated Budget Field
requirements.definition: Populate each applicable agreement's allocated-budget field with the supplied full program allocation, distinct from the amount consumed by the particular subcontract.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the allocated-budget field and its site-specific values; the explanatory note distinguishing the full allocation from the subcontract amount is a separate independently reviewable output.

requirements.title: Full-Budget and Subcontract-Amount Explanation
requirements.definition: Include the required short explanation when the full allocated program budget exceeds the amount used by the subcontract.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers only the explanatory text; entering the allocated-budget figure and calculating the subcontract total can be completed or corrected independently.

requirements.title: Service Schedule Fields
requirements.definition: Represent each site's supplied service days, times, and date range accurately and consistently across the agreement's Term and Schedule fields.
requirements.boundary_note: Days, times, and date ranges are parameters of one site schedule; the Annex B weeks-served figure and monetary labor calculation remain separately testable Requirements.

requirements.title: Annex B Weeks Served Field
requirements.definition: Correct the Annex B Page 2 weeks-served figure for the FCC/FH and 154Q/201 agreements from 6.75 weeks to 4 weeks.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the independently reviewable weeks-served field; associated schedule dates and resulting salary calculations are separate behaviors.

requirements.title: Agreement Site Name
requirements.definition: Use the client-selected school identity on each completed agreement while accounting for the FCC/FH and 154Q/201 naming relationships.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the displayed school name and alias resolution only; no separate Contract ID Requirement is established because the IDs were unavailable and no definitive rendering rule was supplied.

requirements.title: Subcontractor Signature Placement
requirements.definition: Ensure the applicable agreements are signed in the subcontractor section rather than the contractor section.
requirements.boundary_note: Signature presence and placement can fail or be corrected independently of budget, schedule, and calculation fields.

requirements.title: Salary and Wages Support Sheet
requirements.definition: Include the requested salary and wages support sheet as part of the applicable subcontract documentation.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers inclusion and completion of the independently requested support-sheet artifact; its labor formula and budget-gap allocation rules are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Session-Based Labor Calculation
requirements.definition: Calculate personnel costs from the applicable total sessions or weeks, rates, and hours rather than assuming a uniform weekly meeting pattern or inflating labor merely to consume the full budget.
requirements.boundary_note: Session count, weeks, rates, and hours are inputs to one labor-cost mechanism; allocating the remaining budget to non-personnel categories is independently changeable.

requirements.title: Permitted Budget-Gap Allocation
requirements.definition: Reconcile the difference between calculated salary costs and the subcontract total using only permitted non-personnel categories, such as travel and consumable supplies.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers category selection and allocation of the residual budget only; personnel calculations and the allocated-budget field remain separate Requirements.

unresolved_candidates.description: The signature-section correction is clearly required, but the supplied text does not identify whether the affected revised document is FCC/FH or 154Q/201.
